model: MiniMax H3 DiT (Olivia DMAD-PDMD int8, 20.29 GB, 50 blocks, hidden 5376, 56 heads x 128, ffn 14336)
hardware: Kaggle 2x Tesla T4 15360 MiB, PCIe via host bridge, no P2P, ComfyUI v0.44.2, torch 2.13.0+cu130
notes: tokens = latent_t x (H/32) x (W/32), latent_t = ((frames-5)//17)*5+2 with frames aligned to n%17==5. Measured 2026-11-09 with portkit-style runs (tests/h3_upscale m0, m1).

limitations: Step times are means of two progress gaps; cold initialization is excluded from these gaps. Job times include graph work beyond sampling.
Exchange A/B uses different seeds and only two gaps per job; 4% is an estimate.
Harness does not establish calibrated int8 baseline error, full-forward correlation, single-GPU speedup, or unsupported-model fallback. Block comparison is only block0 on one input.
Legacy measured section retains earlier measurements at their original token counts.
